params.topic: Eliteserien 2018-2025 missing pre-kickoff standings and fixture identity from the official NFF site
params.execution_note: This is the first source in a user-requested sequential, one-website-at-a-time recovery. Check and scrape only the official Norwegian Football Federation site at fotball.no and pages or data endpoints it owns. Do not search or fetch another website in this task. If fotball.no cannot supply a field, mark it unavailable/blocked with the attempted URL and reason; stop this source pass so the next website can be requested separately. Use the existing accepted Eliteserien fixture artifact from req-20261017-002 and the second-meeting target list from req-20261017-003 where available. Do not re-run broad source discovery already covered by req-20261017-001. The sole season scope is Norway calendar seasons 2018 through 2025 inclusive. Exclude 2026 completely.
questions: Using only fotball.no, locate official fixture or match pages for the 960 Eliteserien fixtures with meeting_number=2 in req-20261017-002/003. Return each source match ID and direct URL and map it to the existing record_key, season, round, home team, away team, and actual kickoff instant when the page proves the match identity. Preserve original team spellings and any ambiguity; do not force a match.

For those same fixtures, retrieve the official league table immediately before kickoff when fotball.no provides it. For both teams return rank, points, played, goals_for, goals_against, goal_difference, the table snapshot date/time, and evidence that the snapshot precedes the actual kickoff. A final-season table or a post-match round table is not acceptable. Preserve NULL for unavailable fields and do not infer standings from the target match result.

For the unresolved fixture identities listed in the local supplement remaining_missing.csv for seasons 2018-2025, use fotball.no only to look for an official match ID and exact fixture identity. Return a row only when teams, season, round/date and kickoff evidence identify one unique match; otherwise report the candidates and ambiguity without selecting one.

Audit coverage separately for the expected 960 second-meeting fixtures, 1,920 team-side standings rows, and unresolved fixture-identity targets: expected, discovered, complete, partial, unavailable, blocked, conflict, and parse_failed counts by season. Define complete standings as both teams having all requested fields from a table snapshot proven to be before kickoff.

Keep this task to raw historical facts and source evidence. Do not return odds, scores or results as prediction inputs, Qimen/chart data, model direction, probabilities, Snapshot, Outcome, Review, Gold, or conclusions. Never use 2026 data.
